title: TridiVision: functions and editions
tile1_desc: Height, step, flatness and coplanarity, distance and angle on point clouds and height maps; features fitted on the cloud; multi-camera stitching.
tile2_desc: Classification, semantic segmentation and object detection — models trained in AI Training, run in AI Runtime.
tile3_desc: Annotation and training from a small image set; camera, hand–eye and multi-camera calibration on the Bigframe targets.
tile4_desc: Object recognition with grasp guidance and path planning from the point cloud; results and signals to PLCs, MES and robots.
editions_lede: Five editions on a USB hardware key; each includes everything in the edition before it.
ed_2d_modules: 1D inspection; 2D positioning and measurement; image processing; defect detection; calibration; computation; communication
ed_zmap_modules: everything in 2D, plus 3D Z-map positioning, measurement and processing
ed_cloud_modules: everything in 3D Z-map, plus 3D recognition, robot path planning and point-cloud processing
ed_runtime_modules: everything in 3D Point Cloud, plus deep-learning inference
ed_training_modules: everything in AI Runtime, plus deep-learning training
sysreq_text: GPU acceleration with NVIDIA CUDA; a CoaXPress frame grabber in the host computer for the TRS series. Operating system, memory and GPU as stated in the installation guide. Sample programs for typical applications ship with the software.
